# Stage 1: Build amg2023
# Use Ubuntu 22.04 as the base image for its modern toolchain
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set DEBIAN_FRONTEND to noninteractive to prevent interactive prompts during package installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, compilers, git, certificates, and OpenMPI
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    git \
    ca-certificates \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev && \
    # Clean up apt cache to reduce image size
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure OpenMPI for containerized/cloud environments like Kubernetes
# 1. Allow OpenMPI to run as the root user, which is the default in this container.
# 2. Force TCP communication for inter-process communication, which is compatible with standard Kubernetes networking.
# 3. Disable shared memory mechanisms that may not work correctly across different nodes/pods.
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT=1
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT_CONFIRM=1
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=tcp,self
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none

# Create a temporary directory for the build process, clone the source code, compile it,
# install the executable, and then clean up to keep the final image lean.
RUN mkdir -p /tmp/build && \
    cd /tmp/build && \
    # Clone the latest version of the amg2023 repository
    git clone https://github.com/LLNL/AMG2023.git && \
    cd AMG2023/test && \
    # Compile the application using the provided Makefile
    make && \
    # Copy the final executable to a directory on the system's PATH
    cp amg /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    # Clean up the build source to minimize final image size
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /tmp/build

# Set a default working directory for when the container is run
WORKDIR /data

# Stage 1: Build amg2023
# Use Ubuntu 22.04 as the base image for its modern toolchain
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set DEBIAN_FRONTEND to noninteractive to prevent interactive prompts during package installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, compilers, git, certificates, and OpenMPI
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    git \
    ca-certificates \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev && \
    # Clean up apt cache to reduce image size
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure OpenMPI for containerized/cloud environments like Kubernetes
# 1. Allow OpenMPI to run as the root user, which is the default in this container.
# 2. Force TCP communication for inter-process communication, which is compatible with standard Kubernetes networking.
# 3. Disable shared memory mechanisms that may not work correctly across different nodes/pods.
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT=1
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT_CONFIRM=1
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=tcp,self
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none

# Create a temporary directory for the build process, clone the source code, compile it,
# install the executable, and then clean up to keep the final image lean.
RUN mkdir -p /tmp/build && \
    cd /tmp/build && \
    # Clone the latest version of the amg2023 repository
    git clone https://github.com/LLNL/AMG2023.git && \
    # FIX: Change directory to the repository root where the Makefile is located.
    cd AMG2023 && \
    # Compile the application using the provided Makefile
    make && \
    # Copy the final executable to a directory on the system's PATH
    cp amg /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    # Clean up the build source to minimize final image size
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /tmp/build

# Set a default working directory for when the container is run
WORKDIR /data

# Stage 1: Build amg2023
# Use Ubuntu 22.04 as the base image for its modern toolchain
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set DEBIAN_FRONTEND to noninteractive to prevent interactive prompts during package installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, compilers, git, certificates, OpenMPI, and the HYPRE dependency
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    git \
    ca-certificates \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    # FIX: Install the HYPRE library, a required dependency for amg2023
    libhypre-dev && \
    # Clean up apt cache to reduce image size
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure OpenMPI for containerized/cloud environments like Kubernetes
# 1. Allow OpenMPI to run as the root user, which is the default in this container.
# 2. Force TCP communication for inter-process communication, which is compatible with standard Kubernetes networking.
# 3. Disable shared memory mechanisms that may not work correctly across different nodes/pods.
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT=1
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT_CONFIRM=1
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=tcp,self
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none

# Create a temporary directory for the build process, clone the source code, compile it,
# install the executable, and then clean up to keep the final image lean.
RUN mkdir -p /tmp/build && \
    cd /tmp/build && \
    # Clone the latest version of the amg2023 repository
    git clone https://github.com/LLNL/AMG2023.git && \
    # Change directory to the repository root where the Makefile is located.
    cd AMG2023 && \
    # FIX: Compile the application, overriding Makefile variables to use the system-installed HYPRE
    # and disable other non-existent dependencies like CUDA and Umpire.
    make HYPRE_INC="-I/usr/include/hypre" HYPRE_LIB_PATH="" CUDA_INC="" CUDA_LIB_PATH="" UMPIRE_INC="" UMPIRE_LIB_PATH="" && \
    # Copy the final executable to a directory on the system's PATH
    cp amg /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    # Clean up the build source to minimize final image size
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /tmp/build

# Set a default working directory for when the container is run
WORKDIR /data

# Stage 1: Build amg2023
# Use Ubuntu 22.04 as the base image for its modern toolchain
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set DEBIAN_FRONTEND to noninteractive to prevent interactive prompts during package installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, compilers, git, certificates, OpenMPI, and the HYPRE dependency
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    git \
    ca-certificates \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    libhypre-dev && \
    # Clean up apt cache to reduce image size
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure OpenMPI for containerized/cloud environments like Kubernetes
# 1. Allow OpenMPI to run as the root user, which is the default in this container.
# 2. Force TCP communication for inter-process communication, which is compatible with standard Kubernetes networking.
# 3. Disable shared memory mechanisms that may not work correctly across different nodes/pods.
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT=1
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT_CONFIRM=1
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=tcp,self
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none

# Create a temporary directory for the build process, clone the source code, compile it,
# install the executable, and then clean up to keep the final image lean.
RUN mkdir -p /tmp/build && \
    cd /tmp/build && \
    # Clone the latest version of the amg2023 repository
    git clone https://github.com/LLNL/AMG2023.git && \
    # Change directory to the repository root where the Makefile is located.
    cd AMG2023 && \
    # FIX: Directly override the final INCLUDES variable in the Makefile to ensure
    # the compiler uses the system-installed HYPRE headers, bypassing hardcoded defaults.
    make INCLUDES="-I. -I/usr/include/hypre" HYPRE_LIB_PATH="" CUDA_LIB_PATH="" UMPIRE_LIB_PATH="" && \
    # Copy the final executable to a directory on the system's PATH
    cp amg /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    # Clean up the build source to minimize final image size
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /tmp/build

# Set a default working directory for when the container is run
WORKDIR /data

# Stage 1: Build amg2023
# Use Ubuntu 22.04 as the base image for its modern toolchain
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set DEBIAN_FRONTEND to noninteractive to prevent interactive prompts during package installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, compilers, git, certificates, OpenMPI, and the HYPRE dependency
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    git \
    ca-certificates \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    libhypre-dev && \
    # Clean up apt cache to reduce image size
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure OpenMPI for containerized/cloud environments like Kubernetes
# 1. Allow OpenMPI to run as the root user, which is the default in this container.
# 2. Force TCP communication for inter-process communication, which is compatible with standard Kubernetes networking.
# 3. Disable shared memory mechanisms that may not work correctly across different nodes/pods.
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT=1
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT_CONFIRM=1
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=tcp,self
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none

# Create a temporary directory for the build process, clone the source code, compile it,
# install the executable, and then clean up to keep the final image lean.
RUN mkdir -p /tmp/build && \
    cd /tmp/build && \
    # Clone the latest version of the amg2023 repository
    git clone https://github.com/LLNL/AMG2023.git && \
    # Change directory to the repository root where the Makefile is located.
    cd AMG2023 && \
    # FIX: Explicitly disable CUDA and Umpire via Makefile flags to prevent linker errors
    # for a CPU-only build, while ensuring the system-installed HYPRE library is used.
    make USE_CUDA=0 USE_UMPIRE=0 INCLUDES="-I. -I/usr/include/hypre" HYPRE_LIB_PATH="" && \
    # Copy the final executable to a directory on the system's PATH
    cp amg /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    # Clean up the build source to minimize final image size
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /tmp/build

# Set a default working directory for when the container is run
WORKDIR /data

# Stage 1: Build amg2023
# Use Ubuntu 22.04 as the base image for its modern toolchain
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set DEBIAN_FRONTEND to noninteractive to prevent interactive prompts during package installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, compilers, git, certificates, OpenMPI, and the HYPRE dependency
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    git \
    ca-certificates \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    libhypre-dev && \
    # Clean up apt cache to reduce image size
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure OpenMPI for containerized/cloud environments like Kubernetes
# 1. Allow OpenMPI to run as the root user, which is the default in this container.
# 2. Force TCP communication for inter-process communication, which is compatible with standard Kubernetes networking.
# 3. Disable shared memory mechanisms that may not work correctly across different nodes/pods.
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT=1
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT_CONFIRM=1
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=tcp,self
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none

# Create a temporary directory for the build process, clone the source code, compile it,
# install the executable, and then clean up to keep the final image lean.
RUN mkdir -p /tmp/build && \
    cd /tmp/build && \
    # Clone the latest version of the amg2023 repository
    git clone https://github.com/LLNL/AMG2023.git && \
    # Change directory to the repository root where the Makefile is located.
    cd AMG2023 && \
    # FIX: Build for CPU by directly specifying include paths and libraries,
    # bypassing the Makefile's flawed detection for CUDA/Umpire which was causing linker errors.
    make INCLUDES="-I/usr/include/hypre" LIBS="-lHYPRE -lm" && \
    # Copy the final executable to a directory on the system's PATH
    cp amg /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    # Clean up the build source to minimize final image size
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /tmp/build

# Set a default working directory for when the container is run
WORKDIR /data

# Stage 1: Build amg2023
# Use Ubuntu 22.04 as the base image for its modern toolchain
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set DEBIAN_FRONTEND to noninteractive to prevent interactive prompts during package installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, compilers, git, certificates, OpenMPI, and the HYPRE dependency
# along with its own dependencies (BLAS, LAPACK)
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    git \
    ca-certificates \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    libhypre-dev \
    # FIX: Install BLAS and LAPACK development libraries, which are dependencies for HYPRE.
    libblas-dev \
    liblapack-dev && \
    # Clean up apt cache to reduce image size
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure OpenMPI for containerized/cloud environments like Kubernetes
# 1. Allow OpenMPI to run as the root user, which is the default in this container.
# 2. Force TCP communication for inter-process communication, which is compatible with standard Kubernetes networking.
# 3. Disable shared memory mechanisms that may not work correctly across different nodes/pods.
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT=1
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT_CONFIRM=1
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=tcp,self
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none

# Create a temporary directory for the build process, clone the source code, compile it,
# install the executable, and then clean up to keep the final image lean.
RUN mkdir -p /tmp/build && \
    cd /tmp/build && \
    # Clone the latest version of the amg2023 repository
    git clone https://github.com/LLNL/AMG2023.git && \
    # Change directory to the repository root where the Makefile is located.
    cd AMG2023 && \
    # FIX: Add BLAS and LAPACK libraries (-lblas, -llapack) to the linker command
    # to resolve the "undefined reference" errors for HYPRE functions.
    make INCLUDES="-I/usr/include/hypre" LIBS="-lHYPRE -llapack -lblas -lm" && \
    # Copy the final executable to a directory on the system's PATH
    cp amg /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    # Clean up the build source to minimize final image size
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /tmp/build

# Set a default working directory for when the container is run
WORKDIR /data

# Stage 1: Build amg2023
# Use Ubuntu 22.04 as the base image for its modern toolchain
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set DEBIAN_FRONTEND to noninteractive to prevent interactive prompts during package installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, compilers, git, certificates, OpenMPI,
# and dependencies for building HYPRE from source (e.g., BLAS, LAPACK).
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    git \
    ca-certificates \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    # The correct version of HYPRE will be built from source as a submodule.
    # We keep BLAS and LAPACK as they are required by HYPRE's own build process.
    libblas-dev \
    liblapack-dev && \
    # Clean up apt cache to reduce image size
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure OpenMPI for containerized/cloud environments like Kubernetes
# 1. Allow OpenMPI to run as the root user, which is the default in this container.
# 2. Force TCP communication for inter-process communication, which is compatible with standard Kubernetes networking.
# 3. Disable shared memory mechanisms that may not work correctly across different nodes/pods.
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT=1
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT_CONFIRM=1
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=tcp,self
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none

# Create a temporary directory for the build process, clone the source code with submodules,
# compile it, install the executable, and then clean up to keep the final image lean.
RUN mkdir -p /tmp/build && \
    cd /tmp/build && \
    # FIX: Clone the repository and its 'hypre' submodule to ensure the correct dependency
    # version is used, resolving the version mismatch with system packages.
    git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/LLNL/AMG2023.git && \
    # Change directory to the repository root where the Makefile is located.
    cd AMG2023 && \
    # FIX: Use a simple 'make' command. The Makefile is designed to automatically build the
    # bundled HYPRE submodule first, then build amg2023 against it, avoiding all linker issues.
    make && \
    # Copy the final executable to a directory on the system's PATH
    cp amg /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    # Clean up the build source to minimize final image size
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /tmp/build

# Set a default working directory for when the container is run
WORKDIR /data

# Stage 1: Build amg2023
# Use Ubuntu 22.04 as the base image for its modern toolchain
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set DEBIAN_FRONTEND to noninteractive to prevent interactive prompts during package installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, compilers, git, certificates, OpenMPI,
# and dependencies for building HYPRE from source (e.g., BLAS, LAPACK).
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    git \
    ca-certificates \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    # The correct version of HYPRE will be built from source as a submodule.
    # We keep BLAS and LAPACK as they are required by HYPRE's own build process.
    libblas-dev \
    liblapack-dev && \
    # Clean up apt cache to reduce image size
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure OpenMPI for containerized/cloud environments like Kubernetes
# 1. Allow OpenMPI to run as the root user, which is the default in this container.
# 2. Force TCP communication for inter-process communication, which is compatible with standard Kubernetes networking.
# 3. Disable shared memory mechanisms that may not work correctly across different nodes/pods.
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT=1
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT_CONFIRM=1
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=tcp,self
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none

# Create a temporary directory for the build process, clone the source code with submodules,
# compile it, install the executable, and then clean up to keep the final image lean.
RUN mkdir -p /tmp/build && \
    cd /tmp/build && \
    # Clone the repository and its 'hypre' submodule.
    git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/LLNL/AMG2023.git && \
    # Change directory to the repository root where the Makefile is located.
    cd AMG2023 && \
    # FIX: The Makefile is properly configured to build the hypre submodule as a
    # dependency. The previous explicit build step was incorrect. Call the main target.
    make amg && \
    # Copy the final executable to a directory on the system's PATH
    cp amg /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    # Clean up the build source to minimize final image size
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /tmp/build

# Set a default working directory for when the container is run
WORKDIR /data

# Use Ubuntu 22.04 as the base image for its modern toolchain
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set DEBIAN_FRONTEND to noninteractive to prevent interactive prompts during package installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, compilers, git, certificates, OpenMPI,
# and dependencies for building HYPRE from source (e.g., BLAS, LAPACK).
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    git \
    ca-certificates \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    # The correct version of HYPRE will be built from source as a submodule.
    # We keep BLAS and LAPACK as they are required by HYPRE's own build process.
    libblas-dev \
    liblapack-dev && \
    # Clean up apt cache to reduce image size
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure OpenMPI for containerized/cloud environments like Kubernetes
# 1. Allow OpenMPI to run as the root user, which is the default in this container.
# 2. Force TCP communication for inter-process communication, which is compatible with standard Kubernetes networking.
# 3. Disable shared memory mechanisms that may not work correctly across different nodes/pods.
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT=1
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT_CONFIRM=1
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=tcp,self
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none

# Create a temporary directory for the build process, clone the source code with submodules,
# compile it, install the executable, and then clean up to keep the final image lean.
RUN mkdir -p /tmp/build && \
    cd /tmp/build && \
    # Clone the repository and its 'hypre' submodule.
    git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/LLNL/AMG2023.git && \
    # Change directory to the repository root where the Makefile is located.
    cd AMG2023 && \
    # FIX: Override Makefile variables to point to the local hypre submodule.
    # This ensures the compiler finds the correct header files (like HYPRE_config.h)
    # by bypassing the Makefile's incorrect, hardcoded paths.
    make HYPRE_DIR=./hypre HYPRE_INC_FLAGS="-I./hypre/src -I./hypre/src/hypre/include" amg && \
    # Copy the final executable to a directory on the system's PATH
    cp amg /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    # Clean up the build source to minimize final image size
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /tmp/build

# Set a default working directory for when the container is run
WORKDIR /data

    cd / && \

# Stage 1: Build amg2023
# Use Ubuntu 22.04 as the base image for its modern toolchain
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set DEBIAN_FRONTEND to noninteractive to prevent interactive prompts during package installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, compilers, git, certificates, OpenMPI,
# and dependencies required for building the HYPRE library from source.
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    git \
    ca-certificates \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    libblas-dev \
    liblapack-dev && \
    # Clean up apt cache to reduce image size
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure OpenMPI for containerized/cloud environments like Kubernetes
# 1. Allow OpenMPI to run as the root user, which is the default in this container.
# 2. Force TCP communication for inter-process communication, which is compatible with standard Kubernetes networking.
# 3. Disable shared memory mechanisms that may not work correctly across different nodes/pods.
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT=1
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT_CONFIRM=1
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=tcp,self
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none

# Create a temporary directory for the build process, clone the source code, build the
# hypre dependency, build the amg application, install the executable, and clean up.
RUN mkdir -p /tmp/build && \
    cd /tmp/build && \
    # Clone the repository and its 'hypre' submodule to ensure the correct dependency version.
    git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/LLNL/AMG2023.git && \
    # First, build and install the hypre library from its submodule. This is a prerequisite
    # for building the main application as it generates required headers (e.g., HYPRE_config.h).
    cd AMG2023/hypre/src && \
    ./configure && \
    make -j$(nproc) && \
    make install && \
    # Return to the main application's source directory
    cd /tmp/build/AMG2023 && \
    # Now, build the amg application. Its Makefile will automatically find the
    # hypre library that was just installed in the system path.
    make amg && \
    # Copy the final executable to a system directory on the PATH
    cp amg /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    # Clean up the build source to minimize final image size
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /tmp/build

# Set a default working directory for when the container is run
WORKDIR /data

# Stage 1: Build amg2023
# Use Ubuntu 22.04 as the base image for its modern toolchain
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set DEBIAN_FRONTEND to noninteractive to prevent interactive prompts during package installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, compilers, git, certificates, OpenMPI,
# and dependencies required for building the HYPRE library from source.
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    git \
    ca-certificates \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    libblas-dev \
    liblapack-dev && \
    # Clean up apt cache to reduce image size
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure OpenMPI for containerized/cloud environments like Kubernetes
# 1. Allow OpenMPI to run as the root user, which is the default in this container.
# 2. Force TCP communication for inter-process communication, which is compatible with standard Kubernetes networking.
# 3. Disable shared memory mechanisms that may not work correctly across different nodes/pods.
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT=1
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT_CONFIRM=1
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=tcp,self
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none

# Create a temporary directory for the build process, clone the source code, build the
# hypre dependency, build the amg application, install the executable, and clean up.
RUN mkdir -p /tmp/build && \
    cd /tmp/build && \
    # Clone the repository and its 'hypre' submodule to ensure the correct dependency version.
    git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/LLNL/AMG2023.git && \
    # First, build and install the hypre library from its submodule. This is a prerequisite
    # for building the main application as it generates required headers (e.g., HYPRE_config.h).
    cd AMG2023/hypre/src && \
    ./configure && \
    make -j$(nproc) && \
    make install && \
    # Return to the main application's source directory
    cd /tmp/build/AMG2023 && \
    # Now, build the amg application. Its Makefile will automatically find the
    # hypre library that was just installed in the system path.
    make amg && \
    # Copy the final executable to a system directory on the PATH
    cp amg /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    # Clean up the build source to minimize final image size
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /tmp/build

# Set a default working directory for when the container is run
WORKDIR /data

# Stage 1: Build amg2023
# Use Ubuntu 22.04 as the base image for its modern toolchain
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set DEBIAN_FRONTEND to noninteractive to prevent interactive prompts during package installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, compilers, git, certificates, OpenMPI,
# and dependencies required for building the HYPRE library from source.
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    git \
    ca-certificates \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    libblas-dev \
    liblapack-dev && \
    # Clean up apt cache to reduce image size
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure OpenMPI for containerized/cloud environments like Kubernetes
# 1. Allow OpenMPI to run as the root user, which is the default in this container.
# 2. Force TCP communication for inter-process communication, which is compatible with standard Kubernetes networking.
# 3. Disable shared memory mechanisms that may not work correctly across different nodes/pods.
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT=1
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT_CONFIRM=1
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=tcp,self
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none

# Create a temporary directory for the build process, clone the source code, build the
# hypre dependency, build the amg application, install the executable, and clean up.
RUN mkdir -p /tmp/build && \
    cd /tmp/build && \
    # Clone the repository and its 'hypre' submodule to ensure the correct dependency version.
    git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/LLNL/AMG2023.git && \
    # First, build and install the hypre library from its submodule. This is a prerequisite
    # for building the main application as it generates required headers (e.g., HYPRE_config.h).
    cd AMG2023/hypre/src && \
    ./configure && \
    make -j$(nproc) && \
    make install && \
    # Return to the main application's source directory
    cd /tmp/build/AMG2023 && \
    # Now, build the amg application. Its Makefile will automatically find the
    # hypre library that was just installed in the system path.
    make amg && \
    # Copy the final executable to a system directory on the PATH
    cp amg /usr/local/bin/amg && \
    # Clean up the build source to minimize final image size
    cd / && \
    rm -rf /tmp/build

# Set a default working directory for when the container is run
WORKDIR /data
